issues.explanation: The call transition is written by hand instead of reusing the existing Ticket::call(), duplicating domain logic and letting future guards or events added there silently diverge from this path.
The TODO asking to link the test covering the single-call invariant once implemented is left in place even though the change adds those tests, so the documentation is stale.
The fairness-history ordering test yields the same outcome whichever direction the id tie-break sorts (the last three are never all priority), so the required id tie-break is not actually verified.
No test asserts that called tickets from another queue are excluded from the fairness history; only candidate selection is checked for queue isolation.
The Ticket::retrieved listeners used to simulate a concurrent call are never removed, so they remain registered globally for later tests in the same process.

review.summary: Adds the CallNextTicket action with CallMode and NoWaitingTicketsException, covering deterministic ordering, the 3-priority fairness rule, queue/candidate locking and exactly-once handling, with docs and a substantial Pest suite. All contract and behavior requirements appear met; the PR is approvable with nits, mainly reusing Ticket::call() instead of duplicating it and removing the stale architecture TODO.
